messages.content: Rewrite this one-day trip request the way a real traveller might type it: change the wording and the sentence order, informal is fine. Keep EVERY number, time (exactly as written, 24-hour HH:MM), money amount and place name exactly as written. Do not add, drop or change any requirement. Output only the rewritten request.

I'm free from 10:00 to 16:25. My budget is S$6. I definitely need to see National Museum of Singapore and Fort Canning Park. If there's time, I'd also like Tekka Centre, Merlion Park, Peranakan Museum, East Coast Lagoon Food Village and Adventure Cove Waterpark. I want to do Fort Canning Park before National Museum of Singapore. I want to do National Museum of Singapore before Fort Canning Park.

response: Hey, I've got a window from 10:00 to 16:25 and a budget of S$6. I really need to hit up Fort Canning Park and National Museum of Singapore, just make sure I do National Museum of Singapore before Fort Canning Park (wait, actually can you do Fort Canning Park before National Museum of Singapore?). If I can squeeze more in, I'd also love to see Tekka Centre, Merlion Park, Peranakan Museum, East Coast Lagoon Food Village and Adventure Cove Waterpark.
